entry.title: Tool-Augmented Memory for Long-Horizon Agents: A Retrieval-Write Policy Learned with GRPO
entry.summary: We propose a learned read/write policy over an external memory for tool-using agents. Trained with GRPO on synthetic long-horizon tasks, the policy raises success rate from 31% to 68% on 200k-step tasks while cutting context tokens by 5x. Code: https://github.com/example/tamem

entry.title: A Note on the Convergence of Stochastic Gradient Descent for Shallow Networks
entry.summary: We give a refined convergence rate for SGD on two-layer networks under a mild separability assumption, improving the constant in prior bounds.

entry.title: FlashKV: Compressing KV Cache with Learned Low-Rank Projections for 4x Longer Contexts
entry.summary: FlashKV learns per-layer low-rank projections of keys and values, reducing KV cache memory by 4x with under 0.3 point perplexity degradation on long-context benchmarks, and integrates with vLLM paged attention.
